title: ESMA Museum and Site of Memory
geometryBasis: The named 12-corner Officers’ Quarters footprint on OpenStreetMap way 219731998 anchors the connected exterior and two open rear courts. The rectangular brick-pier entrance projects toward Avenida del Libertador. The designation and the model cover the Officers’ Quarters building.
sectionBasis: Two original July 2013 photographs show white three-storey plaster wings with dark shuttered windows, the lower wing with tall court windows, and rear higher plaster-and-brick masses with clay tile roofs. Argentina’s nomination records added pitched roofs, exposed brick corners and the entrance porch. Original terrain fixes the approach datum and the slope into both rear courts.
limitations: The modern mapped main-building envelope is used for the July 2013 exterior. The entrance porch projection, roof sections, wing heights, bay spacing and southeast assignment of the low rear arm are visual estimates.
The two 2013 photographs establish the material palette and the distinction between the low arm and the three-storey wings. Main avenue elevation details are reconstructed from the written record.
The original 128-meter elevation field remains unchanged. Ground contact, the approach steps and the exposure of the textured base are estimates at the original provider resolution.
The model depicts the exterior before the 2014–2015 exhibit works. Its date range applies to the represented 2013 state.
